setup.parameters: m0>0, g>0, lambda>=0, externally fixed beta in (0,infinity), spatial circumference L tending to infinity
setup.interaction: W4=(g/4)sum_e q_e^4+(lambda/4)sum_(e~f)(q_e-q_f)^2(q_e^2+q_f^2), P_pl(q)=q^T K_pl q/2+W4(q), with one fixed real symmetric K_pl and one fixed scalar density e_pl
setup.reference: the common massive eight-component plane Gaussian field and plane-Wick convention; every identity is first written at one common ultraviolet cutoff and then the finite covariance differences are removed
setup.finite_volume_law: periodic beta by L Euclidean torus, with the normalized interacting density relative to the free periodic Gaussian law

volume_coherence.plane_to_torus_difference: D_pl(beta,L)=C_(beta,L)-C_pl=(1/(2pi)) sum_((n,r) in Z^2 except (0,0)) K0(m0 sqrt(n^2 beta^2+r^2 L^2))>0
volume_coherence.cylinder_decomposition: D_pl(beta,L)=a_beta+a_L+M_(beta,L), where M is the positive image sum with both winding integers nonzero; hence D_pl(beta,L) tends to a_beta and e_(beta,L) tends to e_(star,beta) as L tends to infinity
volume_coherence.Hamiltonian_coordinates: the first heat trace uses K_(star,L),e_(star,L) on S_L and the exchanged transfer Hamiltonian uses K_(star,beta),e_(star,beta) on S_beta
volume_coherence.necessity: without one fixed K_pl,e_pl or an equivalent coherent L-flow, the EXP-000774 fixed-L Hamiltonians need not define one thermodynamic theory and Nelson exchange is not licensed

Nelson_symmetry_and_pressure.dual_Hamiltonian: quantize the same plane-Wick action along the L direction on the dual spatial circle S_beta, obtaining H_beta^perp with compact resolvent and a unique ground energy E_beta; H_(0,beta) has ground energy zero
Nelson_symmetry_and_pressure.pressure_limit: lim_(L->infinity)L^(-1)log Z_rel(beta,L)=-E_beta and p_rel(beta)=lim_(L->infinity)(beta L)^(-1)log Z_rel=-E_beta/beta
Nelson_symmetry_and_pressure.scalar_shift: adding c to the interaction density sends E_beta to E_beta+c beta and p_rel to p_rel-c; therefore the raw pressure limit exists in the declared convention but its sign is not scalar-gauge invariant

specific_relative_entropy.finite_volume_identity: for free mu_(beta,L) and normalized interacting nu_(beta,L), D(mu||nu)=log Z_rel+E_mu I_(beta,L)
specific_relative_entropy.transfer_expectation: whole-torus Wick centering gives E_mu I_(beta,L)=beta L e_(beta,L) exactly; D_pl(beta,L)->a_beta gives T_beta=beta e_(star,beta)=<Omega_(0,beta),V_beta Omega_(0,beta)>=q_(H_beta^perp)[Omega_(0,beta)] and lim L^(-1)E_mu I=T_beta, without a coupling derivative
specific_relative_entropy.strict_witness: for one species and normalized four-zero-mode chi on S_beta, q_(H_beta^perp)(chi,Omega)=(g+3lambda)sqrt(4!)/(16 beta m0^2)>0; a form-domain Rayleigh trial proves E_beta<T_beta
specific_relative_entropy.centered_form: for Hhat_beta=H_beta^perp-T_beta I, E0(Hhat_beta)=E_beta-T_beta<0 and lim[-D(mu||nu)/(beta L)]=E0(Hhat_beta)/beta<0
specific_relative_entropy.gauge_invariance: a common scalar density shift adds c beta to both T_beta and E_beta, so T_beta-E_beta and s_rel are invariant

periodic_state_limit.ground_projection: compact resolvent and positivity improvement give a simple dual ground and a positive gap delta_beta; normalized exp(-L H_beta^perp) converges to its ground projection
periodic_state_limit.local_limit: periodic finite-L Schwinger functionals for transfer-representable bounded local insertions converge through the dual-ground matrix elements to a periodic infinite-line Euclidean local functional at the externally fixed beta; no global density-matrix convergence across changing Hilbert spaces is asserted
periodic_state_limit.transfer_mixing: the positive dual spectral gap gives exponential mixing in spatial separation for transfer-representable bounded local observables, with support widths absorbed into the observable-dependent constant
periodic_state_limit.KMS_boundary: a full noncommutative infinite-volume beta-KMS state on a common local algebra requires an explicit finite-component Gerard-Jaekel/Araki-Woods local-algebra bridge and is not proved by ground projection alone
periodic_state_limit.boundary: this does not prove full KMS-algebra reconstruction, uniqueness among every possible infinite-volume boundary condition, or a beta-to-infinity phase theorem

physical_and_phase_boundary.empty_space: the free Gaussian reference law is fixed by inserted m0, Euclidean geometry and field normalization and is not independently derived as cosmic empty space; K_pl and e_pl instead specify the interacting comparison theory and its scalar convention
physical_and_phase_boundary.absolute_energy: the raw pressure sign changes under an additive scalar density; only the relative-entropy or centered variational gap is invariant
physical_and_phase_boundary.global_measure: positive specific relative entropy concerns limits of finite-volume or local restrictions; it does not assert a finite global Radon-Nikodym density or finite total infinite-volume relative entropy
physical_and_phase_boundary.zero_temperature: the theorem fixes beta<infinity; it does not interchange beta->infinity with L->infinity or prove a zero-temperature ground-energy density, phase transition or spontaneous symmetry breaking
physical_and_phase_boundary.parent: the volume-coherent family is a newly declared inserted one-dimensional Euclidean Q3 theory, not the original fixed-raw CL8 family or a derived three-dimensional Q3LOCK parent

no_overclaim: This theorem concerns a newly declared volume-coherent massive Q3 family at each externally fixed finite beta. It proves a convention-dependent raw relative-pressure limit, a convention-independent strictly positive specific relative entropy against the named Gaussian reference, and a bounded-local Euclidean transfer limit. It does not prove a full noncommutative infinite-volume KMS algebra, that the raw pressure is absolutely negative, that the reference is physical empty space, that total infinite-volume relative entropy is finite, or that a global density exists. It proves no beta-to-infinity and L-to-infinity interchange, zero-temperature phase transition, spontaneous symmetry breaking, interacting Hadamard/microlocal spectrum, original fixed-raw CL8 or three-dimensional Q3 parent, physical light, C0, N1-N5, C6, CP1, Sector A or Pre-A.
